## Plan + test matrix (Phase 1)

Design source: `docs/build/planning/2026-09-30-next-phase/design/K4-dossier-index.md`
§3.3 (the R1–R8 rule table + closed check vocabulary), §3.4 (disclosure +
unplaced quality surfaces), §5.3 (placement columns + jurisdiction block),
§4.4 (strict `LOAD spatial`, never a runtime `INSTALL` on the export path).

1. `exports/src/exports/placement.py` — the `placement@1` engine:
   `PlacementEngine(pack_dir, registry)` verifies the staged boundary
   pack via `boundary_pack.verify_pack` (refuses missing/tampered/
   divergent roots — `boundaries_root` cross-checked against the
   registry's `boundary_pack` binding + per-source vintages), builds the
   DuckDB-spatial boundary index from the verified GeoParquet layers
   (minting layers only; rollup layers unioned like
   `build_registry`'s `rollup` clauses), then `place_many(inputs)`
   batch-joins points → per-level candidates → pure-Python R1–R8
   evaluation. R2 ambiguous containment reports `inconsistent_input`
   (fail closed), never a guessed winner.
   - Boundary order: country → admin-1 → county → municipality (R6
     chain); MO/KS deterministic tie-break + NE 0.02° tolerance on
     `non_us`-role layers only.
   - Closed `placement_check` vocabulary (single source of truth —
     public validators + the quality report read the same tuple):
     `inside_declared`, `inside_declared_country`,
     `outside_declared_country`, `outside_declared`, `declared_level`,
     `within_tolerance`, `declared_only`, `axis_swap_suspected`,
     `sign_flip_suspected`, `no_geometry`, `unreported`, `partial_depth`,
     `no_containing_country`, `name_unmatched`, `name_ambiguous`,
     `unmatched`, `point_rejected:<R1 reason>`; R1 reasons:
     `invalid_point`, `null_island`. A geometry guard refusal
     (`geometry_precision.assert_point_in_polygon_usable`,
     SIG-IDENT-004 — `organization_centroid_or_unknown` and any
     non-point precision) lands as `no_geometry`; a coordinate-flagged
     record whose point is withheld lands as `no_geometry_unusable`
     internally mapped to the named check the flag names
     (`axis_swap_suspected`/`sign_flip_suspected`/`null_island`).
   - Landed `geometry_defect` claims (P35.16/PKG-06b) are consumed as
     inputs when present (`axis_swap`/`sign_flip`/`null_island` → the
     matching suspected/rejected check without re-testing;
     `wrong_jurisdiction` leaves the point usable); absent → the
     engine's own variant checks apply (K4 §3.3 note).
   - `PlacementResult` carries `jurisdiction_key`, `jurisdiction_chain`,
     `placement_basis` (`point_in_polygon`|`declared`|`name_lookup`),
     `placement_check`, `declared` `{scheme,value}|null`,
     `boundary_vintage`, `point_withheld`, plus declared/located keys for
     the disclosure counts.
2. `spine_export._slice_sites` — optional `placement` engine + per-source
   claim index; a placement run annotates each site row with the seven
   additive columns (`jurisdiction_key`, `jurisdiction_chain`,
   `placement_basis`, `placement_check`, `declared_scheme`,
   `declared_value`, `boundary_vintage`) and withholds the emitted
   `latitude`/`longitude` when the point is suspect/rejected (raw
   coordinates stay on the claim rows; the published site row never
   re-emits a flagged point). Legacy `jurisdiction` is unchanged
   (declared bucket, back-compat). No placement engine ⇒ byte-identical
   output.
3. `EXPORT_QUERIES["geometry_defects"]` — additive gated read of landed
   `geometry_defect` claims (subject → class set) feeding the engine's
   `defect_flags` input; pre-P35.16 spines degrade to `[]` honestly.
4. `_map_layer` — under a placement run only `point_in_polygon` rows
   draw (declared-basis and rejected/withheld points never draw; legacy
   behaviour unchanged without placement).
5. `web/placement.json` — `sig.placement-report/1`: ruleset, check
   vocabulary, boundary provenance (`boundaries_root` + per-source
   vintages), per-source `by_check` quality counts with conservation
   (`total == sum(by_check)`), located-vs-declared disclosure pairs
   (`declared`, `located`, `count`). Emitted only when placement ran —
   absent otherwise (honest absence, same posture as
   `checkpoint-audit`).
6. `published_record` — `sig.published-record/3`: the record's
   `jurisdiction` object gains the placement block (`key`, `chain`,
   `basis`, `check`, `declared {scheme,value}|null`,
   `boundary_vintage`); `null` placement block when a release predates
   placement (additive, never a fabricated placement).
7. `cli.py` — `--boundary-pack`/`--jurisdiction-registry` on
   `build --from-spine` (mutually required pair; pack verification is
   the gate — fixture-bypass packs never ship a production descriptor
   because `boundary_pack.verify_pack` still binds their declared
   inputs root). `run_spine_export`/`build_spine_export` gain the same
   optional kwargs.
8. `ops/gcp/export.sh` — `SIG_EXPORT_BOUNDARY_PACK`/`SIG_EXPORT_REGISTRY`
   envs add the flags only when set (absent ⇒ byte-identical args ⇒ no
   placement, honest absence).
9. `ops/Dockerfile` — bake `duckdb` `spatial` at image build (the
   pinned 1.5.5 lock) so the export path's strict `LOAD spatial` never
   needs a runtime `INSTALL` (K4 §4.4).
10. Public changelog `## [Unreleased]` entry (spine_export.py is in
    the changelog-gate's public-behaviour path set — P35.18 hit the same
    gate).
11. Tests (`tests/exports/test_placement.py` +
    `test_spine_export.py` additions):
    - fixture matrix over `boundary_pack_fixtures` (build a small
      fixture pack in tmp_path, stage it, verify, place): inside_declared;
      California-declared point in Florida → `outside_declared_country`,
      located `iso3166-2:US-FL` wins, disclosure pair counted; cross-
      country declared → `outside_declared`; MO/KS border → deterministic
      lowest-code winner `contested`→resolved by rule; NE coast point
      within 0.02° → `within_tolerance`; declared-only (config scope,
      no coords) → `declared_only`; sig.unresolved → `unreported`;
      `(0,0)` → `point_rejected:null_island`, unplaced, never drawn;
      non-US point with no containing country → `no_containing_country`;
      state found but county/place absent → `partial_depth` + chain
      stops at the found level; Nottingham axis-swap →
      `axis_swap_suspected`, declared-level key, point withheld, never
      drawn/counted as located; sign-flip variant inside declared →
      `sign_flip_suspected`; flagged record with no declared → unplaced
      with the named check; `organization_centroid`/`unknown` precision
      → `no_geometry` (SIG-IDENT-004 — never point-placed);
      `name_unmatched`/`name_ambiguous` for R8 non-site inputs.
    - integration: `_slice_sites` with the engine emits the seven
      columns + withheld lat/lon; `_map_layer` draws only
      `point_in_polygon`; `web/placement.json` schema-valid,
      conservation + disclosure counts; `record_from_site_row` emits
      the /3 jurisdiction block; absent engine ⇒ all surfaces
      byte-identical (back-compat); no-spine-write — placement runs
      inside `run_spine_export`'s read-only snapshot and the engine
      touches only its own DuckDB.
    - fail-closed: absent pack dir, tampered layer, registry/pack
      `boundaries_root` divergence → `PlacementError`, export refuses.

implementation settled. Per-deliverable:

1. **Engine + spatial pinning** — `exports/placement.py` (1,131 lines):
   strict `LOAD spatial` with a verbatim-error `PlacementError`
   (never a runtime `INSTALL`); the image bakes the extension at the
   lock-pinned DuckDB (`ops/Dockerfile`). One batched `place_many` join
   per run — not per-record round trips. **Met.**
2. **R1–R8 in order, first match wins** — `_place` evaluates
   defect-flags → R1 reject → no-usable-point (R5) → located chain
   (R2, tie-break + `on_boundary`) → R4 disagreement → R3 variant

   per the contract — I8 is a downstream row). Partial depth emits
   `not_evaluated` (`deeper_unevaluated` — an evaluated-but-empty level
   stops the chain; a never-reached level marks it). **Met.**
   Sequencing detail recorded: defect-flags run BEFORE R1 — a landed
   detector verdict is an input, and the contract's "consumes PKG-06b
   detectors if landed" places them upstream of the engine's own checks.

   stamps `sites_columns()`; `record_from_site_row` emits the §3.4

  path is pack/registry CONSTRUCTION (offline tooling behind
  `sig-exports boundaries build`), not the export placement path,
  which is strict `LOAD` only (`_strict_spatial`). Left as-is;
  recorded so the distinction is explicit.
- `PRIOR_RELEASE_ID` re-pin (p-ad9c…→p-7b7f…): verified — the
  regenerated-id error message gave the candidate, the re-pinned suite
  is 30/30, and the only byte difference vs the /2 projection is the
  `sig.published-record/3` schema string + the additive jurisdiction
  fields (the corpus's site rows carry no placement columns, so the
  block is absent — same mechanism as P35.15a's re-pin).
- Consistency detail worth recording: `_locate` stops the walk on the
  first missed level ("the chain stops there") — a county-layer gap
  means a deeper place hit is `not_evaluated`, never grafted mid-chain.
- Residual risk: fixture polygons are stand-ins (degree-boxes +
  registry-built rollup unions); they exercise the rules and the
  verified-pack binding honestly but do not validate TIGER/NE vintage
  content itself — that verification rides the first real pack staging
  under the next export row's authority.
